fullText.simplified:
吕布一对三

    董卓听说他的花将军被杀了，就让吕布带军队和元少他们打。
    吕布很厉害，他骑着马，拿着大刀，跑在最前面。元少的一个将军出去和他打，没打几下，发现自己打不过吕布，就忙往回跑。吕布不放过这个将军，骑着马跟在他后面，拿起大刀就要杀他。这个时候，只听见有人大叫道：“我张飞在这里，吕布你别想杀人！”
    吕布一看，是一个大黑脸在说话。这个大黑脸骑着马，很快到了他身边。吕布没办法，放过了那个将军，和张飞打。他们打了很久，还在打。
    关羽看到自己的弟弟和吕布打了那么久，还在打。他很着急，就骑马去和张飞一起打吕布。
    现在，吕布一个人对两个人，但是他一点儿也不害怕，而且越打越厉害。刘备看到自己的两个弟弟打了那么久，还在打。他很着急，也骑马去帮助张飞和关羽。
    现在，吕布一个人对三个人。他们打了很久，慢慢地，吕布累了，只能往回跑，想回城里。刘备、关羽和张飞不放过吕布，他们骑着马跟在吕布后面。元少的军队看到吕布往回跑了，很高兴，他们跟在刘备三人后面。就这样，大家进城了。
    董卓看到元少的军队进城了，很着急。他马上带皇帝一起跑了。
fullText.traditional:
呂布一對三

    董卓聽說他的花將軍被殺了，就讓呂布帶軍隊和元少他們打。
    呂布很厲害，他騎著馬，拿著大刀，跑在最前面。元少的一個將軍出去和他打，沒打幾下，發現自己打不過呂布，就忙往回跑。呂布不放過這個將軍，騎著馬跟在他後面，拿起大刀就要殺他。這個時候，只聽見有人大叫道：“我張飛在這裡，呂布你別想殺人！”
    呂布一看，是一個大黑臉在說話。這個大黑臉騎著馬，很快到了他身邊。呂布沒辦法，放過了那個將軍，和張飛打。他們打了很久，還在打。
    關羽看到自己的弟弟和呂布打了那麼久，還在打。他很著急，就騎馬去和張飛一起打呂布。
    現在，呂布一個人對兩個人，但是他一點兒也不害怕，而且越打越厲害。劉備看到自己的兩個弟弟打了那麼久，還在打。他很著急，也騎馬去幫助張飛和關羽。
    現在，呂布一個人對三個人。他們打了很久，慢慢地，呂布累了，只能往回跑，想回城裡。劉備、關羽和張飛不放過呂布，他們騎著馬跟在呂布後面。元少的軍隊看到呂布往回跑了，很高興，他們跟在劉備三人後面。就這樣，大家進城了。
    董卓看到元少的軍隊進城了，很著急。他馬上帶皇帝一起跑了。

sentences.simplified: 董卓听说他的花将军被杀了，就让吕布带军队和元少他们打。
sentences.traditional: 董卓聽說他的花將軍被殺了，就讓呂布帶軍隊和元少他們打。
sentences.pinyin: dǒng zhuó tīng shuō tā de huā jiāng jūn bèi shā le jiù ràng lǚ bù dài jūn duì hé yuán shào tā men dǎ
sentences.english: Dong Zhuo heard that General Hua had been killed, so he had Lü Bu take his troops to fight Yuan Shao’s people.

sentences.simplified: 吕布很厉害，他骑着马，拿着大刀，跑在最前面。
sentences.traditional: 呂布很厲害，他騎著馬，拿著大刀，跑在最前面。
sentences.pinyin: lǚ bù hěn lì hai tā qí zhe mǎ ná zhe dà dāo pǎo zài zuì qián miàn
sentences.english: Lü Bu was very formidable. He rode his horse, carried his large sword, and ran at the front.

sentences.simplified: 元少的一个将军出去和他打，
sentences.traditional: 元少的一個將軍出去和他打，
sentences.pinyin: yuán shào de yí ge jiāng jūn chū qù hé tā dǎ
sentences.english: Yuan Shao’s first general went to fight him.

sentences.simplified: 没打几下，发现自己打不过吕布，就忙往回跑。
sentences.traditional: 沒打幾下，發現自己打不過呂布，就忙往回跑。
sentences.pinyin: méi dǎ jǐ xià fā xiàn zì jǐ dǎ bú guò lǚ bù jiù máng wǎng huí pǎo
sentences.english: After only a few blows, the general realized that he wasn’t going to be able to beat Lü Bu, so he quickly retreated.

sentences.simplified: 吕布不放过这个将军，骑着马跟在他后面，拿起大刀就要杀他。
sentences.traditional: 呂布不放過這個將軍，騎著馬跟在他後面，拿起大刀就要殺他。
sentences.pinyin: lǚ bù bú fàng guò zhè ge jiāng jūn qí zhe mǎ gēn zài tā hòu miàn ná qǐ dà dāo jiù yào shā tā
sentences.english: Lü Bu didn’t let this general off the hook, and followed him on horse and holding a large sword, wanting to kill him.

sentences.simplified: 这个时候，只听见有人大叫道：
sentences.traditional: 這個時候，只聽見有人大叫道：
sentences.pinyin: zhè ge shí hou zhǐ tīng jiàn yǒu rén dà jiào dào
sentences.english: At this moment, he heard someone shouting, ..

sentences.simplified: “我张飞在这里，吕布你别想杀人！”
sentences.traditional: “我張飛在這裡，呂布你別想殺人！”
sentences.pinyin: wǒ zhāng fēi zài zhè lǐ lǚ bù nǐ bié xiǎng shā rén
sentences.english: .. “I, Zhang Fei, am here; Lü Bu, don’t you even think about killing anyone!”

sentences.simplified: 吕布一看，是一个大黑脸在说话。
sentences.traditional: 呂布一看，是一個大黑臉在說話。
sentences.pinyin: lǚ bù yí kàn shì yí ge dà hēi liǎn zài shuō huà
sentences.english: Lü Bu looked over and saw a large, dark face talking.

sentences.simplified: 这个大黑脸骑着马，很快到了他身边。
sentences.traditional: 這個大黑臉騎著馬，很快到了他身邊。
sentences.pinyin: zhè ge dà hēi liǎn qí zhe mǎ hěn kuài dào le tā shēn biān
sentences.english: This large, dark face was riding a horse, and quickly arrived at his side.

sentences.simplified: 吕布没办法，放过了那个将军，和张飞打。他们打了很久，还在打。
sentences.traditional: 呂布沒辦法，放過了那個將軍，和張飛打。他們打了很久，還在打。
sentences.pinyin: lǚ bù méi bàn fǎ fàng guò le nà ge jiāng jūn hé zhāng fēi dǎ tā men dǎ le hěn jiǔ hái zài dǎ
sentences.english: Lü Bu had no choice but to let that general go and fight Zhang Fei. They fought for a long time and were still fighting.

sentences.simplified: 关羽看到自己的弟弟和吕布打了那么久，还在打。
sentences.traditional: 關羽看到自己的弟弟和呂布打了那麼久，還在打。
sentences.pinyin: guān yǔ kàn dào zì jǐ de dì di hé lǚ bù dǎ le nà me jiǔ hái zài dǎ
sentences.english: Guan Yu saw that his younger brother had been fighting Lü Bu for so long and was still fighting.

sentences.simplified: 他很着急，就骑马去和张飞一起打吕布。
sentences.traditional: 他很著急，就騎馬去和張飛一起打呂布。
sentences.pinyin: tā hěn zháo jí jiù qí mǎ qù hé zhāng fēi yì qǐ dǎ lǚ bù
sentences.english: He was very worried, so he rode a horse to fight Lü Bu alongside Zhang Fei.

sentences.simplified: 现在，吕布一个人对两个人，但是他一点儿也不害怕，
sentences.traditional: 現在，呂布一個人對兩個人，但是他一點兒也不害怕，
sentences.pinyin: xiàn zài lǚ bù yí ge rén duì liǎng ge rén dàn shì tā yì diǎn'r yě bú hài pà
sentences.english: Now, Lü Bu was one person fighting two people, but he was not even one bit afraid, ..

sentences.simplified: 而且越打越厉害。
sentences.traditional: 而且越打越厲害。
sentences.pinyin: ér qiě yuè dǎ yuè lì hai
sentences.english: .. and the more he fought, the more formidable he became.

sentences.simplified: 刘备看到自己的两个弟弟打了那么久，还在打。
sentences.traditional: 劉備看到自己的兩個弟弟打了那麼久，還在打。
sentences.pinyin: liú bèi kàn dào zì jǐ de liǎng ge dì di dǎ le nà me jiǔ hái zài dǎ
sentences.english: Liu Bei saw that his two younger brothers had been fighting for so long and were still fighting.

sentences.simplified: 他很着急，也骑马去帮助张飞和关羽。
sentences.traditional: 他很著急，也騎馬去幫助張飛和關羽。
sentences.pinyin: tā hěn zháo jí yě qí mǎ qù bāng zhù zhāng fēi hé guān yǔ
sentences.english: He was very worried, so he also rode a horse to go help Zhang Fei and Guan Yu.

sentences.simplified: 现在，吕布一个人对三个人。
sentences.traditional: 現在，呂布一個人對三個人。
sentences.pinyin: xiàn zài lǚ bù yí ge rén duì sān ge rén
sentences.english: Now, Lü Bu was one person against three people.

sentences.simplified: 他们打了很久，慢慢地，吕布累了，只能往回跑，想回城里。
sentences.traditional: 他們打了很久，慢慢地，呂布累了，只能往回跑，想回城裡。
sentences.pinyin: tā men dǎ le hěn jiǔ màn man de lǚ bù lèi le zhǐ néng wǎng huí pǎo xiǎng huí chéng lǐ
sentences.english: They fought for a long time, and slowly, Lü Bu started getting tired. He could only retreat back towards the city.

sentences.simplified: 刘备、关羽和张飞不放过吕布，他们骑着马跟在吕布后面。
sentences.traditional: 劉備、關羽和張飛不放過呂布，他們騎著馬跟在呂布後面。
sentences.pinyin: liú bèi guān yǔ hé zhāng fēi bú fàng guò lǚ bù tā men qí zhe mǎ gēn zài lǚ bù hòu miàn
sentences.english: Liu Bei, Guan Yu, and Zhang Fei did not let Lü Bu off the hook. They followed Lü Bu on horse.

sentences.simplified: 元少的军队看到吕布往回跑了，很高兴，他们跟在刘备三人后面。
sentences.traditional: 元少的軍隊看到呂布往回跑了，很高興，他們跟在劉備三人後面。
sentences.pinyin: yuán shào de jūn duì kàn dào lǚ bù wǎng huí pǎo le hěn gāo xìng tā men gēn zài liú bèi sān rén hòu miàn
sentences.english: Yuan Shao’s troops saw that Lü Bu was retreating and were very happy. They followed behind Liu Bei’s group of three.

sentences.simplified: 就这样，大家进城了。
sentences.traditional: 就這樣，大家進城了。
sentences.pinyin: jiù zhè yàng dà jiā jìn chéng le
sentences.english: Just like that, everyone entered the city.

sentences.simplified: 董卓看到元少的军队进城了，很着急。
sentences.traditional: 董卓看到元少的軍隊進城了，很著急。
sentences.pinyin: dǒng zhuó kàn dào yuán shào de jūn duì jìn chéng le hěn zháo jí
sentences.english: Dong Zhuo saw that Yuan Shao’s troops entered the city and was very worried.

sentences.simplified: 他马上带皇帝一起跑了。
sentences.traditional: 他馬上帶皇帝一起跑了。
sentences.pinyin: tā mǎ shàng dài huáng dì yì qǐ pǎo le
sentences.english: He immediately took the emperor with him and fled.

sentence_translations: Lü Bu 1 vs. 3
Dong Zhuo heard that General Hua had been killed, so he had Lü Bu take his troops to fight Yuan Shao’s people.
Lü Bu was very formidable. He rode his horse, carried his large sword, and ran at the front.
Yuan Shao’s first general went to fight him.
After only a few blows, the general realized that he wasn’t going to be able to beat Lü Bu, so he quickly retreated.
Lü Bu didn’t let this general off the hook, and followed him on horse and holding a large sword, wanting to kill him.
At this moment, he heard someone shouting, ..
.. “I, Zhang Fei, am here; Lü Bu, don’t you even think about killing anyone!”
Lü Bu looked over and saw a large, dark face talking.
This large, dark face was riding a horse, and quickly arrived at his side.
Lü Bu had no choice but to let that general go and fight Zhang Fei. They fought for a long time and were still fighting.
Guan Yu saw that his younger brother had been fighting Lü Bu for so long and was still fighting.
He was very worried, so he rode a horse to fight Lü Bu alongside Zhang Fei.
Now, Lü Bu was one person fighting two people, but he was not even one bit afraid, ..
.. and the more he fought, the more formidable he became.
Liu Bei saw that his two younger brothers had been fighting for so long and were still fighting.
He was very worried, so he also rode a horse to go help Zhang Fei and Guan Yu.
Now, Lü Bu was one person against three people.
They fought for a long time, and slowly, Lü Bu started getting tired. He could only retreat back towards the city.
Liu Bei, Guan Yu, and Zhang Fei did not let Lü Bu off the hook. They followed Lü Bu on horse.
Yuan Shao’s troops saw that Lü Bu was retreating and were very happy. They followed behind Liu Bei’s group of three.
Just like that, everyone entered the city.
Dong Zhuo saw that Yuan Shao’s troops entered the city and was very worried.
He immediately took the emperor with him and fled.
